notes: Account: mid-size contact center platform serving retail + telco customers. Primary ask: real-time agent assist with streaming suggestions integrated into their agent UI (Chrome extension). E2E suggestion latency target: 100-300ms for single-turn suggestions, sub-150ms token latency for streaming. Throughput: during promos expect bursts to 12k concurrent agents, avg qps per agent ~0.5. Must support model fallbacks (larger model for quality, smaller for cost/latency during spikes). Requires strict guardrails: hallucination detection, configurable do-not-call tool list, interactive tool-calling to their CRM with audit trail. Data residency: EU for EU customers but want US infra for HQ. Retention policy: 13 months for audit logs. Want SSO + SCIM and KMS integration. POC goal: prove 95th percentile end-to-end suggestion latency under realistic spikes and validate safe tool-calls. AE note: "We need a clear failure-mode - when model unavailable, fallback to cached suggestions or static KB replies."
